US Pentagon awards oil deal to Venezuelan billionaire investigated for money laundering

The U.S. Pentagon has awarded an oil deal to a Venezuelan billionaire who was previously investigated by the U.S. for money laundering. This development has caused unease among Venezuelan opposition members, who are concerned that agreements with the current regime in Caracas could hinder democratic progress. The specific details of the oil deal and the nature of the investigation into the billionaire were not elaborated upon in the provided coverage.
